The '''Malastare Special Service''' was an organization on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The Special Service posted a bounty on [[Jenatahza]] for being a participant in a plot to murder [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] claimed the bounty alive for the Special Service.

The Service also posted a bounty for [[Tahbotza]], for attempted blackmail of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak's]] support staff. This bounty was also claimed by Fett.
